answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 19007 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to use Spirit or Swabs made of Alcohol before taking an injection? A diabetic patient has to take the same twice a day. Is it ok to use Alcoholic swabs? Question: Is it permissible to use Spirit or Swabs made of Alcohol before taking an injection? A diabetic patient has to take the same twice a day. Is it ok to use Alcoholic swabs? Answer ID: 19007 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 181/174/H=1431) Yes, it is permissible. The detail can be seen in Fathul Mulhim etc, but still it is better to wash it with water after getting the injection. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
